dependency-audit.summary: npm audit reported zero production or total dependency vulnerabilities.

secrets-scan.summary: Selected target-tree credential/private-key signature scan found zero matching files; history and entropy remain limitations.

env-config-separation.summary: No tracked .env file, localhost production reference, debug flag, or test-key marker was found in the candidate.

deploy-pipeline-known.summary: Cloudflare Pages Git delivery is documented and the exact main candidate has a merged/deployed read-back in LDK-724.

logging-no-secrets.summary: The static product has no application logging sink and emitted no origin warning/error during the primary-route walkthrough.

https-redirect.summary: HTTP redirected once to HTTPS and primary production routes returned 200.

security-headers-baseline.summary: Production returned nosniff, DENY frame protection, strict-origin referrer policy, and restrictive permissions policy.

csp-hsts-rollout.summary: Production returned neither CSP nor HSTS.

findings.summary: CSP and HSTS are absent from production responses.

responsive.summary: Three primary routes had no document overflow at 375, 768, or 1280; the exact candidate mobile/zoom suite passed.

accessibility.summary: Local axe-core found zero violations on all three primary routes and 104/104 Playwright tests passed; manual WCAG conformance is not claimed.

performance-lab-budget.summary: Production Lighthouse scored 98–100 performance; LCP was 1.62–2.00 s and CLS 0–0.0009 on all three primary routes.

browser-compat.summary: Chromium desktop/mobile passed; Firefox, WebKit, and Safari were not measured.

custom-404-500.summary: Dedicated 404 content and correct 404 status passed, but no bounded production 500 response was available to verify.

broken-links.summary: Complete local scan of 234 built HTML pages found zero broken internal paths.

favicon-og-defaults.summary: Favicon, manifest, default title, and default OG media resolve on the primary routes.

cache-cdn-config.summary: HTML is revalidated, but hashed assets are cached for only four hours rather than an immutable long lifetime.

findings.summary: Hashed static assets use max-age=14400, must-revalidate rather than a long immutable policy.

health-check.summary: The declared production host has no dedicated health endpoint; /health returned 404.

uptime-monitor.summary: No uptime monitor and alert-route receipt was available; creating one is an external/provider mutation outside this run's authority.

findings.summary: Uptime monitor existence and alert delivery are unverified.

error-tracking.summary: No client error-tracking DSN and production test-event receipt was available; no provider mutation was authorized.

findings.summary: Client error tracking and test-event receipt are unverified.

domain-dns-renewal.summary: Registrar auto-renew, recovery contact, and >90-day expiry evidence were unavailable.

seo-audit.summary: Three sitemap URLs disagree with their page canonicals, including two legacy aliases.

findings.summary: The sitemap publishes three non-canonical URLs.

indexability.summary: No noindex meta/header was found and robots.txt allows crawling.

sitemap-robots.summary: robots.txt points to a valid sitemap, but three sitemap URLs are not canonical.

findings.summary: The canonical-only sitemap contract fails for /review/ and two legacy style aliases.

canonical-url-normalization.summary: /review redirects to /review/ while the served page canonical points back to /review; legacy aliases serve 200 with different canonicals.

findings.summary: Canonical and redirect normalization disagree on three published routes.

meta-og-per-page.summary: Titles, descriptions, and canonicals exist across all built HTML, but /review/ lacks OG title/image defaults.

findings.summary: The production review route lacks complete Open Graph defaults.

structured-data.summary: All 233 JSON-LD blocks parsed and primary routes expose Website/Organization-aligned structured data.

orphan-soft404.summary: No sampled soft 404 was found; two legacy alias pages are unlinked and remain in the sitemap.

findings.summary: Two unlinked legacy aliases remain indexable sitemap entries.

gsc-verify.summary: LDK-722 is Done with an owner-visible screenshot of the verified exact production property.

gsc-sitemap-submitted.summary: LDK-723 is Done with exact sitemap submission and processed-success read-backs.

bing-webmaster.summary: No authenticated Bing evidence was available and no external setup mutation was authorized.

ga4-key-events.summary: Analytics is disabled and no GA4 property is part of the production product.

analytics-hygiene.summary: Analytics is disabled and no production analytics collection surface was observed.

looker-dashboard.summary: Analytics is disabled; no GA4-backed Looker dashboard applies.

copy-review.summary: Primary copy contains no placeholder claims; legal/contact statements match the accepted owner decisions and local-first boundary.

cro-primary-cta.summary: The output-first primary CTA is prominent, accurate, and leads directly to a useful result surface.

design-consistency.summary: The editorial atlas direction, shared discovery controls, typography, and semantic lime accent are coherent across the primary routes.

legal-pages.summary: Privacy, terms, and about/contact routes return 200 and match the accountless local-first feature boundary.

contact-works.summary: The public mailto path and SLA are published, but no message was sent and no mailbox receipt/read-back proves delivery within SLA.

findings.summary: End-to-end contact delivery remains unverified and requires separate authority for a real mailbox test.

launch-config-clean.summary: The exact candidate built cleanly and no debug/test configuration leaked into the production output.

form-delivery.summary: Detected form-like controls are local search/Composer interactions with no outbound submission destination.

form-abuse-resilience.summary: No outbound submission endpoint or server-side form surface exists.

form-pii-privacy.summary: Local search and Composer controls do not transmit PII; legal copy documents local storage behavior.
